# Install Manifest

Canonical policy and procedure remain in `core/`.

Source: `skill.tool.install-manifest`

Use this skill when generated vendor install artifacts change.

Write install manifests:

```sh
python3 core/skills/tools/install_manifest.py
```

Check install manifests without changing files:

```sh
python3 core/skills/tools/install_manifest.py --check
```

The manifest records the single selected distribution artifact for each vendor,
whether that artifact is installable by repository-local CLI writes, and the
ordered actions or manual steps for that distribution.

Do not run `py_compile` or `compileall` as part of normal validation. Direct
execution already catches syntax errors and avoids creating repo-local bytecode
cache artifacts.
